verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no rule-definition or event-triggered automation feature in ROS 2. Publish/subscribe topics, services, actions, executors, managed lifecycles and content-filtering subscriptions are developer building blocks: a developer could write code on top of them to approximate event-driven rules, but that does not count as the capability itself. The launch system is described only as coordinating multiple nodes, with no mention of event handlers or rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
